cases.note: A folder holds one version per path and never records the hash Windmill gave it, so no pin can be shown to be the folder's version (SY-15).
cases.title: a pinned script hash is refused

files.f/x/main.flow/flow.yaml:
value:
  modules:
    - id: a
      value: {type: script, path: f/x/s, hash: '0000000000000001'}

cases.title: a provided site may pin a hash

files.f/x/main.flow/flow.yaml:
value:
  modules:
    - id: a
      value: {type: script, path: f/x/s, hash: '0000000000000001'}

given.contract:
roots:
  - flow: f/x/main
provided:
  - selector: {flow: f/x/main, module: a}
    provider: p
    mandatory: true

note: A script step's hash pins a version a folder cannot supply (SY-15); a provided site can stand in for it.
